p: of troops: He forewarns them of the dangers that will come before they enjoy these comforts, showing that inasmuch as Jerusalem was accustomed with her garrisons to trouble others, the Lord would now cause other garrisons to vex her, and that her rulers would be hit on the face most contemptuously.

little among the thousands of Judah: For so the Jews divided their country that for every thousand there was a chief captain: and because Bethlehem was not able to make a thousand, he calls it little. But yet God will raise up his captain and governor in it: and thus it is not the least by reason of this benefit. See Geneva "Mt 2:6"
goings forth have been from of: He shows that the coming of Christ and all his ways were appointed by God from all eternity.
she which travaileth hath brought forth: He compares the Jews to women with child, who for a time would have great sorrows, but at length they would have a comfortable deliverance; Joh 16:21.
stand and feed in the strength: That is, Christ's kingdom will be stable and everlasting, and his people, the Gentiles as well as the Jews, will dwell in safety.
shall be the peace: This Messiah will be a sufficient safeguard for us, and though the enemy invades us for a time, yet will God stir up many who will be able to deliver us.

land of Assyria with the sword: These whom God will raise up for the deliverance of his Church, will destroy all the enemies of it, who are meant here by the Assyrians and Babylonians, who were the chief enemies at that time.
deliver us from the Assyrian: By these governors will God deliver us when the enemy comes into our land.
remnant of Jacob shall be in: This remnant or Church which God will deliver will only depend on God's power and defence (as does the grass of the field), and not on the hope of man.
horses out of the midst of: I will destroy all things in which you put your confidence, such as your vain self-reliance and idolatry, and in doing this I will be helping you.
such as they have not heard: It will be so terrible that nothing like it has been heard of.
